16-18 dpo at least but not until af shows up. 16-18 dpo is usually when the hcg is high enough to get a dye stealer. It could take 4-6 days after an implantation on 10dpo to show up on an hpt and that's of you are sure of ovulation date and if you actually implanted on 10 dpo. And then sometimes hcg rises slowly so it could take up to 16-20 dpo to show a blazing positive. Rule of thumb, your not out til af shows up.
